issue.title: test_agents_pane_mounts_activates_and_loads flakes under the full parallel lane, including on a clean tree

task_type_fields.evidence:
Promoted by `just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake` as a reproducible flake over the durable host record store, on 4 gate-eligible (<=5-failure) full-run records from two independent workspaces on 2026-08-25:

- 20260825T151728Z-9fb3a1805e3c (dirty tree, 5 failures)
- 20260825T152011Z-1a96ea92bf4d (CLEAN tree, 2 failures)
- 20260825T152725Z-9fb3a1805e3c (dirty tree, 3 failures)
- 20260825T153004Z-9fb3a1805e3c (dirty tree, 1 failure)

The clean-tree record is the important one: it rules out uncommitted-source breakage and points at a genuine race rather than a dirty-tree artifact.

PASSES SERIALLY on master f56cf4333: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:randomly tests/ace/tui/test_agents_pane_mount.py::test_agents_pane_mounts_activates_and_loads` gives `1 passed in 8.39s`. It also passed in the full 37073-node check-full run driven from this workspace (monitor hxz0b4zxzgcw, 1h02m), so it does not reproduce on every parallel run.

Reported by epic sase-tt's land agent (sase-tt.land) while triaging the flake gate before closing sase-tt. Not caused by that epic: sase-tt touched no ACE mount path, and every record above predates its land diff.
